posts.zh:
dsh-vision-mix 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1c669cdab2ea3b15b9d8.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision-mix is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1c669cdab2ea3b15b9d8.html
